title: The Figure on the Stairs
description: Halfway up the grand staircase, a man hangs suspended from nothing. No rope, no hook - he simply hangs, feet dangling a foot above the step, head lolling against his shoulder. Then his fingers uncurl. His head rises. His eyes find yours, and you understand he has been waiting.

standard_attack.telegraph: His arm swings out in a wide, boneless arc, fingers splayed and reaching for your throat.

special_attacks.telegraph: His head snaps sideways with a wet crack, and his body begins to rotate slowly in place - as though some invisible hand is winding him tighter and tighter toward you.
His mouth opens wider than any living jaw should allow, and a sound pours out - not a scream, but the silence of every room you've walked through given voice.

pre_combat_narrative: He descends the stairs without bending his knees.

visual.alt_text: A man in a servant's coat suspended mid-stair without support, arms beginning to rise, face tilted upward toward the viewer below.
